Title: Action log records who did what
What it means: Every time someone opens a video or photo, or saves a tag, it is recorded with their name, the time, and whether the save actually worked. Failed saves are recorded too, which is the only way to tell that someone tried and it did not go through.

Title: Fast tag clicking no longer loses tags
What it means: Tapping several tag chips quickly used to keep only the last one. Each tap now adds to the previous one, so all your selections stick.

Title: Video tags now stored one row per video
What it means: All 428 videos' tags used to live in a single record, so every save rewrote all of them at once. Each video now has its own row, so a problem with one video can never affect the others.

Title: A failed save can no longer wipe everyone's work
What it means: If the connection failed at the wrong moment, the app treated it as 'there is no data' and saved over everything. It now stops and shows an error instead. This was the cause of the video tag loss on 30 July.

Title: Kits now charge for their flower components
What it means: A kit's price did not include the flower work inside it, so the header price was lower than the breakdown shown underneath. Both now match. IMPORTANT: this increases kit prices, and saved deals will re-price when reopened.

Title: Recipe shows which flower price it used
What it means: A flower with several colour variants is costed at the cheapest one. The recipe screen now says so, and hovering shows every variant's price, so an edit that does not change the cost is no longer confusing.

Title: Venue search and clearer verified mark
What it means: Added a search box and a 'See all' to the long venue lists. The venue type 'Both' now reads 'Indoor + Outdoor'. The green verified star only shows on photos that actually have elements, and verified photos are listed first.

Title: Add another zone by picking its type
What it means: The Add Zone box is now a dropdown. Pick Stage or Entry Passage and you get a second one that behaves exactly like the original, with its own photos and pricing. Names itself Stage (2), Stage (3) and so on.

Title: Removed the duplicate button from zone rows
What it means: The copy icon on every zone row was crowding the row and is replaced by the Add Zone dropdown.

Title: A photo appears only in the zone it was tagged for
What it means: Photos were showing up under zones they did not belong to.

Title: One light theme everywhere including Manage
What it means: The Manage screens were still dark while the rest of Studio was light.

Title: Upload review screen has the full tag set
What it means: When reviewing an uploaded photo you can now set every tag, not just some of them.

Title: Truss and platform cards plus cost workings
What it means: Related truss and platform cards now sit together, the cost workings are shown, and carpet no longer appears on the wrong list.

Title: Choosing a venue ranks photos instead of hiding them
What it means: Picking a venue used to hide every photo from other venues, often leaving too few to work with. It now shows that venue's photos first and keeps the rest below.

Title: Refreshing on Event Info gives a clean form
What it means: Refreshing the page used to leave stale details in the form.

Title: Extra truss structures and platforms per zone
What it means: A zone can now have more than one truss structure and more than one platform footprint.

Title: Client saves now actually reach the database
What it means: Some client saves were not being stored, and refreshing lost your place in the flow.

Title: Verified photos marked with a star
What it means: A star is easier to see over a photo than the old tick.

Title: Three click targets fixed in the zone list
What it means: Some parts of a zone row did not respond to clicks, or responded when they should not have.

Title: Zone toggle relabelled Details
What it means: The label said 'Details & Pricing' but the button only shows details.

Title: Venue first in the photo filters
What it means: The filter order now matches the Browse page so the two screens feel the same.

Title: Palette filter search and whitespace matching
What it means: Added a ranked search to the palette filter, and stray spaces in a palette name no longer stop it matching.

Title: Every zone can use truss masking platform and carpet
What it means: These options were previously limited to certain zones only.

Title: Truss and platform show on every zone that has them
What it means: Zones configured with truss or platform were not always displaying them.

Title: Masking types are a proper managed list
What it means: Masking types can now be maintained as a list, and the zone structure form opens on an empty zone.

Title: Recently tagged videos stay at the top
What it means: A video you just tagged no longer disappears out of the folder you are working in.

Title: Video verifications no longer revert on refresh
